latest_post.display_name: 名古屋の長期投資家（なごちょう）
latest_post.summary: NOK Group(641A)の中間決算発表。配当利回り約5.16%・暫定BPS4170円でPBR0.65倍と割安だが株価横過いで残念との指摘。Yahoo/株探の表記不備も言及。
latest_post.summary_en: NOK Group (641A) announced its interim financial results, and it was pointed out that although it is undervalued with a dividend yield of approximately 5.16%, a provisional BPS of ¥4,170, and a PBR of 0.65x, it is disappointing that the stock price is moving sideways, while also mentioning notation flaws on Yahoo and Kabutan.
